current_determination: YM-R87 establishes that an Eq(0.29)-type first-layer regular bound alone cannot control CMP116 cross-cutoff activity difference without marginal and multi-sector matching, source transport and a quantitative stability modulus. It derives an abstract uniform Banach-holomorphic one-step activity Lipschitz estimate 2h/rho and a normalized Gaussian complex ratio/response lemma. Counterexamples prove zero regular residual may coexist with nonzero marginal polarization, and an analytic input radius collapsing with the UV scale can destroy activity smallness. Primary Eq(0.29), first-layer dictionary and native Lipschitz/source coupling gate remain open.
